_comment: Value->column inverted index for the compromise.js NLP layer. Maps actual data values (departments, programs, provinces, ridings, NAICS, codes) to the column(s) they appear in, for deterministic entity resolution. Free-text columns are flagged fulltext:true - route those to MATCH...AGAINST, do NOT enumerate. Generated from the normalized grantconts DB.

fulltext_columns._note: Route NL matches against these to MySQL FULLTEXT (MATCH..AGAINST). Do not enumerate values.

recipient_city.note: Enumerated separately on demand; too many to inline. Match exact city names against this column.
